ValidationRule.description: The close date field can only be edited by a DRD user or system admin.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(CloseDate), Bypass_Validation_Rule__c == FALSE, (AND($Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "DRD Profile", $Profile.Name <> "DRD Manager", $Profile.Name <> "APS Planner", $Profile.Name <> "APS Scheduler", $Profile.Name <> "Global Admin", $Profile.Name <> "APS Admin", $Profile.Name <> "Recruitment Admin")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only a DRD user, APS Planner, APS Scheduler, Global Admin ,APS Admin, Recruitment Admin or System Administrator is able to update the Close Date.
